label: Google Drive Backup Folder
description: Sends Backup Set and archive CSV files to a Google Drive folder. Make the connection in Setup first (an Auth Provider for Google, then an External Credential and a Named Credential named BarnConn_gdrive with the URL https://www.googleapis.com and principal OAuth), as the admin guide's Backup Destination section describes. After importing, choose that connection and replace FOLDER_ID in the metadata with the folder's ID from its Drive address.
